In recent years, the Khmer Rouge regime, responsible for the mass killings and political purges of the Khmer Rouge era in Cambodia, has been portrayed as a symbol of oppression and brutality. I. The Factual Basis of the Khmer Rouge's Actions

The Khmer Rouge, also known as the Khmer Rouge Rouge, was a communist regime led by the Khmer Rouge party. Its primary objective was to implement a uniform communist ideology that aimed to transform Cambodia into a socialist state. The regime implemented a series of policies, such as the construction of grandiose architectural structures, the abolition of private property, and the promotion of socialist values. These actions were intended to eliminate social disparities and create a unified society based on Marxist-Leninist principles.
